title: Senior Level Designer
description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

 

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration


\n
$115,000 - $149,500 a year
\n

Because you will be running workshops and presenting directly tobusiness stakeholders and client leadership, excellent business English â spoken and written â is essential to this role.

Key Responsibilities

â¢ Lead and facilitate business process workshops with logistics, supply chain, procurement, and operations stakeholders to capture requirements for a greenfield Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, spanning Inventory Management, Order Management, Indirect Procurement, and related logistics processes.

title: Renewables Project Scheduler
description:
Apply

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

TAKKION is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.
  • Partner with IT and business process owners to identify and implement QMS system enhancements, including defining requirements, driving prioritization and ensuring changes are validated and compliant.
  • Review, approve, and provide quality oversight for validation documentation (e.g., equipment qualification, computer system validation, process validation) for global enterprise systems (e.g. MasterControl, ERP systems, Trackwise, etc.) ensuring alignment with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional and site leadership teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring the QMS evolves in line with business needs and regulatory expectations.


Experience:
  • Bachelorâs degree in a scientific or engineering discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant Quality Assurance or Quality Systems experience in a GxP-regulated environment, with at least 2-3 years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of global quality regulations and standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO 9001, 21 CFR Parts 210/211/820, EU GMP).
  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.
  • Demonstrated success in establishing and trending quality performance metrics and KPIs.
  • Experience supporting and/or administering electronic QMS systems and partnering with IT for system enhancements.
  • Experience working in a multi-site or global quality organization strongly preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functional and site boundaries.


\n
$90,000 - $120,000 a year
\n

The anticipated annual salary range for this job is based on prior experience in the role/industry, education, location, internal equity, and other job-related factors as permitted by law. For remote-based positions, this range may vary based on your local market. Full-time employment positions will also be eligible to receive pre-IPO equity and annual bonus, in addition to competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, PTO, 401(k) plan, life and accidental death and disability coverage, and parental leave benefits. Other perks include subsidized daily lunches and snacks at our on-site locations.

 

Who we are

 

We are driven by a passion for science and compassion for patients. We act with urgency to ensure our treatments are one day accessible to all who need them.

 

We live by our core values of passion, courage, and integrity. Excellence in our work means the chance to unlock a better quality of life for our patients, and with that comes tremendous responsibility.

 

We innovate on a path that hasnât been paved. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and take calculated risks to achieve our mission. We arenât afraid to ask âwhy notâ and challenge the status quo.

 

We maintain a start-up culture of camaraderie and leadership by example, regardless of title.

 

Weâre proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and recognize that celebrating our differences creates stronger, lasting solutions that better serve our team, our patients and their healthcare providers.

 

Notice to staffing firms

 

Orca Bio does not accept resumes from staffing agencies with which we do not have a written agreement and specific engagement for a particular opening. Our employment activities, inquiries and offers are managed through our HR/Talent team, and all candidates are presented through this channel only. We do not accept unsolicited resumes, and we rarely outsource recruitment.

title: Team Lead Education
description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

  • Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

  • Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

  • Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

  • Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

  • Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

  • Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have

  • Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

  • Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

  • Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

  • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you.

Benefits Include:

  • Competitive compensation, including equity

  • Full health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

  • Flexible time off

  • Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Background Checks

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable background checks, where permitted by law.

At-Will Employment

Employment with Pivotal Health is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

What Youâll Be Doing

Improving our help content

Using our support tools

  • Use tools such as Front, Recurly, Customer.io, HubSpot and other internal systems to manage customer conversations, billing questions and account information. We don't expect you to know all of these already, but you should be comfortable learning new software quickly.

Helping customers feel looked after

Working Hours

The exact working pattern will depend on your location and the coverage we agree, but you should be clear in your application about where youâre based and what working hours you would expect to keep.

  • Assist with HR initiatives such as employee engagement events, training programs, and performance review cycles
  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

  • Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

  • Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

  • Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

  • Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

  • Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development.

  • Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended.

  • Hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks: prompt and context design, tool use, handling non-determinism, and evaluating output quality. This is the differentiator for the role.

  • Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing.

  • The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLM systems.

  • Open-source contribution experience.

  • Java, TypeScript or Python; Kubernetes and Helm.

  • Background in developer tooling or platform engineering.

description:

Mapbox is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Security & Compliance team. Engineers on the Security & Compliance team build scanning and threat detection systems to monitor Mapbox’s cloud deployment (AWS-native, mainly container-based, 7 global regions including China) and other digital assets. They conduct risk assessments of new vendor integrations and product launches, and facilitate a bug bounty program that leverages the diverse expertise of a global community of security researchers.   • Make security improvements recommendations and work with our production support teams to implement security improvement in AWS.

  • Partner with the Lead Security Architect in fixing custom-built security tools bots.

  • Conduct in-depth security reviews of application code, working closely with developers to code securely from the outset and address issues early during coding and testing phases.

  • Proficiency in a programming language (e.g. Python, JavaScript or Node.js or TypeScript), testing practices, and documentation.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

  • Family-First Support: Generous maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Rest & Recharge: Flexible paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

  • Invest & Grow: Retirement plans with competitive matching.

Skills

  • Ability to translate operational needs into clear supplier commitments.

  • Lead and develop a team in a collaborative, international engineering environment.

title: Head of Accounting & Tax (f/m/x)
description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

EFS is a fintech company specialising in the financing of decentralised energy solutions such as photovoltaic systems and heat pumps. As a factoring and leasing company and an independent subsidiary of the Enpal Group, we enable installation companies and project developers to offer simple instalment and financing solutions to their customers.

Our mission is to accelerate the energy transition through accessible and customer-focused financing products.

What you’ll do

As Head of Accounting & Tax (f/m/x), you will lead the accounting and tax function at EFS. You will be responsible for reliable HGB and IFRS reporting, timely financial close processes, budgeting, tax compliance and the accounting of factoring / leasing of receivables as well as SPV and financing structures. This is a hands-on role with significant exposure to the business.

  • You own the monthly and annual closing processes for EFS and ensure reliable, high-quality financial reporting.

  • You translate business plans into budgets and forecasts in close collaboration with Enpal Group Finance and relevant business stakeholders.

  • You ensure accurate reporting under HGB and IFRS, including the preparation of IFRS adjustments.

  • You coordinate consolidation and financial statement preparation across relevant entities.

  • You oversee the accounting treatment of factoring and leasing transactions, receivables, financing arrangements, asset transfers and related intercompany transactions.

  • You manage accounting for SPVs, securitisation and other financing structures.

  • You coordinate corporate tax and VAT compliance together with external tax advisors and Enpal Group functions.

  • You build and continuously improve accounting policies, processes and internal controls.

  • You coordinate internal and external audits and ensure that findings are addressed in a timely and structured manner.

  • You further develop the accounting and tax function, including team structures, responsibilities and processes.

  • You drive the automation, scalability and efficiency of reporting and closing processes.

  • You act as a key accounting and tax partner for EFS management and stakeholders across the Enpal Group.

What you’ll bring

  • You hold a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a comparable field.

  • You bring several years of relevant experience in audit, financial reporting, group accounting or a comparable finance function.

  • You have strong knowledge of IFRS and HGB and experience with statutory reporting, consolidation and financial close processes.

  • You are familiar with corporate tax and VAT compliance.

  • You bring relevant experience in factoring, leasing, financial services, lending, receivables management or another asset-finance environment.

  • A background in a Big Four or comparable audit environment is a plus, ideally combined with experience in a start-up, scale-up or other dynamic organisation.

  • Experience with SPVs, securitisation or other financing structures is an advantage.

  • Experience with core banking systems or comparable financial systems is a plus.

  • You work in a structured, pragmatic and solution-oriented way and enjoy improving processes and building scalable structures.

  • You are comfortable working with cross-functional stakeholders and translating complex financial topics into clear, actionable decisions.

  • You are fluent in English; strong German skills are preferred.

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location with regular travel to client sites across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You own the client outcome on our largest strategic accounts, from the moment the contract is signed to the moment the solution is running at scale, and you carry the revenue that comes with it.

Delivering that on a strategic account takes a full blp team: a Senior Project Manager and Project Managers, Integrations Engineers and a Technical Project Manager, a Consultant with AI Automation Specialists, and our Customer Success Engineers. Your job is to make that team deliver for your customers, to hold the relationship at executive level while it happens, and to grow the account once the value is proven. You make sure a strategic customer gets what it was promised: a custom Academy for its teams, priority support, and whatever automation effort it takes to reach the productivity we committed to.

You are not managing a queue and you are not running the project plan. You carry a focused portfolio of our largest customers, and you are the one person accountable for whether they consider blp a success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own net revenue retention and expansion across a focused portfolio of our largest strategic customers.

  • Join late-stage commercial discussions, shape the delivery approach with the Account Executive, and own the client kick-off.

  • Hold the steering committee seat and the relationship with the client's CFO, COO or Head of Shared Services.

  • Act as the trusted advisor and domain expert your clients call before they call anyone else.

  • Orchestrate the functions that serve your accounts, project management, integrations, consulting and support, without managing them directly.

  • Own the value case: set the baseline at go-live, track it, and defend it in the quarterly business review.

  • Be the first point of escalation for your clients. Call a delivery review when a project is off track, require a recovery plan, and hold the organization to it.

  • Identify expansion early, new entities, new processes, new countries, and build the internal case for it.

  • Be the voice of your customers inside blp: collect and structure product feedback from your accounts, and work with Product, Engineering and Sales to translate what clients need into what gets built, without losing sight of blp's own product direction.

  • Turn your best accounts into reference customers: case studies, referenceability, and clients willing to speak publicly about blp.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Ownership Without Authority – You deliver a number that depends on people who do not report to you, and you do it without escalating.

  • Executive Presence – You hold a room where a client executive is unhappy, and you leave it with a decision rather than an action item.

  • Commercial Instinct – You see the expansion before the client asks, and you can build the business case for it.

  • Structured Thinking – You break an ambiguous client situation into a plan with owners and dates.

  • Customer-First Mentality – You care about the client's business outcome, not about defending the project scope.

What You Bring

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 6+ years of experience in strategy consulting, enterprise customer success or account leadership, or senior delivery roles with commercial accountability.

  • Proven track record of owning senior client relationships in complex, multi-stakeholder organizations.

  • Experience running steering committees and holding difficult conversations with executive sponsors.

  • Credible on enterprise finance and supply chain processes. You do not need to configure an ERP, but you need to understand how one is used.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for experience in ERP, AP automation, or AI-driven enterprise SaaS.

How You Grow

Client Partners work closest to our leadership and to our largest customers. From here the paths lead into leading a team of Client Partners, into senior commercial roles, or into leading a delivery or consulting function. Many of our Client Partners come from Senior Project Manager or Senior Consultant roles, and we are explicit about what that step requires.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Your Career Path in Consulting

Our Consulting team has a clear path, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the impact you have had, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • AI Automation Specialist: Hands-on in the automation itself: you tune agents, run automation sprints and take your first own customers end to end. Typically you bring up to 2 years of experience.

  • Consultant: You own a portfolio of live customers as their run lead, including health, growth and account economics. Typically you bring 3+ years in consulting, process improvement or ERP process ownership.

  • Senior Consultant: Our most complex and sensitive accounts, at executive level, and you coach the Consultants and Specialists around you. Typically you bring several years of leading process change at customers.

  • Next steps: Lead a Consulting team, or become a Client Partner on our strategic accounts.

Moves into Project Management or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Your Mission

For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where our Consulting team sits.

Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organization that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Our job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.

This is also where our AI meets the real world, and the real world is messy. When a customer goes live, our agents start processing their documents: invoices, order confirmations, delivery notes, in dozens of formats from thousands of suppliers, with layouts nobody has seen before. Most of it works immediately. The rest is where we come in.

A concrete example. Our AI learns a customer's business logic from their own history. By reading how they have accounted invoices in the past, blp infers the rules they have been applying and makes them explicit. Sometimes it cannot close the loop on its own, because the same kind of invoice was historically booked in two or three different ways and there is no consistent rule to find. In those cases blp asks. It needs the answer once, and every future case follows it. Making sure that answer arrives, and that it is the right one, is our job. Done well, each of those conversations builds trust and removes a category of manual work permanently.

As an AI Automation Specialist

You are hands-on in the automation itself. You configure and tune the agents so they work for a specific customer, dig into exceptions until you find the actual cause rather than patching the symptom, and run automation sprints: the push after each go-live to the target automation rate, and focused sprints our customers book to take their automation further.

Key Responsibilities

Automation and performance

Pipeline creation and territory strategy

  • Build and execute a territory/account plan: target accounts, stakeholders, sequencing, and multi-threading strategy.

Insight-led selling and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing and introduce a sharper point of view on where value is trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls).

  • Own the business case, pricing strategy, proposals, negotiation, and contracting.

Orchestration across presales and delivery

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers to run workshops/demos and de-risk technical concerns (security, integration, rollout).

  • Ensure clean handoffs from close to kickoff, maintaining continuity of value narrative and outcomes.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Anticipate and neutralize competitive plays with crisp differentiation and proof.

 

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 5–10+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS selling experience (or equivalent complex solution sales), with a consistent track record of hitting/exceeding targets.

  • Proven ability to run insight-led enterprise sales cycles: you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and mobilize buying committees.

  • Strong executive presence with CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services and comfort navigating enterprise procurement.

Strong plus

  • ERP/SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or selling into finance/procurement/shared services transformations.

  • Experience selling automation platforms (workflow/RPA/process mining/IDP) and winning against incumbents.

  • Experience with global enterprise rollouts and multi-country stakeholders.

Language

  • Fluent in English and German (or another major European language depending on territory).

 

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

title: Software Architect (x)
description:
Über Greenflash

Wir arbeiten für etwas, das größer ist als wir selbst.
Wir gestalten die Energieversorgung der Industrie von morgen. Das erfordert Menschen mit Ambitionen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und einen spürbaren Beitrag leisten wollen.

Wir vertrauen Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

Wir wachsen gemeinsam.
Große Ziele entstehen nicht durch Routine. Sie entstehen durch Lernen, Feedback und den Mut, neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen. Genau dafür schaffen wir das passende Umfeld.


Deine Mission

  • Softwarearchitektur gestalten: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die technische Architektur unserer Software und triffst gemeinsam mit dem Team fundierte Architekturentscheidungen.
  • Technische Beratung: Du berätst Entwicklungsteams und Fachbereiche bei technischen Fragestellungen, bewertest unterschiedliche Ansätze und findest pragmatische Lösungen.
  • Energie & Software verbinden: Du bringst dein Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung und Energiewirtschaft zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige technische Konzepte.
  • Architektur in die Umsetzung bringen: Du begleitest die Entwicklung von der technischen Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass Architekturentscheidungen auch im Produkt ankommen.
  • Sparring & Standards: Du bist technischer Sparringspartner für unsere Entwickler, schaffst Orientierung bei komplexen Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team technische Standards weiter.
  • Verantwortung übernehmen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einen Teilbereich unserer EVU-Entwicklung und bringst deine Erfahrung ein, um unsere Software und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Mit aufbauen: Du hast Gestaltungsspielraum und wirkst am Aufbau unseres Bereichs für Energieversorger aktiv mit.


Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und idealerweise bereits Erfahrung als Software Architect, Technical Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit.
  • Energiewirtschaft: Du kennst die Energiewirtschaft und verstehst die fachlichen Zusammenhänge rund um Energieversorger.
  • Architekturverständnis: Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge erfassen, Architekturentscheidungen fundiert treffen und diese verständlich vermitteln.
  • Beratungsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne als technischer Sparringspartner, stellst die richtigen Fragen und kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen.
  • Innovations- & Optimierungsdrang: Du hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und bringst neue Ideen in die Umsetzung.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, triffst Entscheidungen und bewegst dich sicher in einem Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit Produktverantwortung sowie Python, Airflow, Pandas, Energieflussprognosen oder Energieeinkauf und Intraday-Trading.


Warum Greenflash

  • Arbeite an etwas, das zählt.
    Die Energiewende gehört zu den größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Bei Greenflash arbeitest du nicht an irgendeinem Projekt, sondern an Lösungen, die Unternehmen nachhaltiger, unabhängiger und zukunftsfähiger machen. Dein Beitrag wird sichtbar: in Projekten, bei Kunden und in den Ergebnissen, die wir gemeinsam erreichen.
  • Mehr Verantwortung. Früher.
    Wer Initiative zeigt und etwas bewegen möchte, bekommt die Chance dazu. Entscheidungen treffen die Menschen, die nah am Thema sind. So entstehen Geschwindigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. 
  • Wachstum durch Herausforderungen.
    Persönliche Entwicklung beginnt dort, wo die Komfortzone endet. Deshalb setzen wir auf spannende Aufgaben, ehrliches Feedback und Verantwortung statt auf standardisierte Karriereprogramme. Ergänzt wird das durch unsere Greenflash Academy und den täglichen Austausch mit Menschen, die ihr Wissen gerne teilen.
  • Leistung, die sichtbar wird
    Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Ergebnisse und der Beitrag zum gemeinsamen Erfolg. Gute Leistung schafft Vertrauen. Vertrauen schafft Verantwortung. Und Verantwortung schafft Entwicklung. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen über sich hinauswachsen können und stolz auf das sind, was sie erreichen. 
  • Ein Team mit Ambition
    Wir arbeiten an großen Zielen und glauben daran, dass außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse durch außergewöhnliche Teams entstehen. Deshalb setzen wir auf Offenheit, direkte Zusammenarbeit und Menschen, die füreinander einstehen. Ohne Politik. Ohne Silodenken. Dafür mit viel Vertrauen, Respekt und dem gemeinsamen Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden.
  • Teil einer außergewöhnlichen Reise
    Greenflash ist nicht einfach ein Arbeitgeber. Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit dem Anspruch, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten. Wer heute bei Greenflash startet, wird Teil einer Entwicklung, die gerade erst begonnen hat.
  • Erfolge gemeinsam erleben
    Wir arbeiten mit hohen Ansprüchen. An unsere Arbeit. An unsere Ergebnisse. An uns selbst. Genauso wichtig ist, dass wir Erfolge gemeinsam feiern. Ob bei Team-Events, auf dem Padel-Court oder im Alltag – wir glauben daran, dass starke Leistung und starke Teams zusammengehören.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:

freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”.

In mehr als zwei Jahrzehnten haben wir immer das ausgeliefert, was wir versprochen haben – “always on time, on budget, on target and on quality”.

85% unserer Members sind Software Engineers mit Abschlüssen in Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik, viele auch mit fundierten Kenntnissen in Maschinellem Lernen und Künstlicher Intelligenz.

Seit über einem Vierteljahrhundert arbeiten wir für das „Who’s Who“ der deutschen und europäischen Industrie- und Handelsunternehmen. Retail, Automotive, E-Commerce, Healthcare und mehr.

Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz.

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”.

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.


ÜBER DEINEN JOB

Wir sind eine Engineering Organisation – auf jeder Ebene sind bei uns Engineers verantwortlich – auch in der Sicherheit. Deshalb kann nur ein echter Engineer unsere Security verantworten. Als Senior Security Engineer bist Du Primus inter Pares: Du beherrschst das Handwerk exzellent und steuerst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team die Compliance bei freiheit.com über Code und Automation.

Deine Rolle & Perspektive: 

  • Führung mit Ziel: Du steigst an der Seite der aktuellen Leitung ein, lernst unsere Systeme tiefgreifend kennen und übernimmst mittelfristig die vollständige Führung des Security-Teams (direkt unter dem CEO).

  • Strategischer Weitblick: Du planst technologische und regulatorische Anforderungen für die nächsten 6 bis 24 Monate proaktiv voraus.

  • Engineering & Automation: Du entwickelst Infrastruktur selbst und automatisierst manuelle Aufwände konsequent durch Code.

description:

Performance Recruiting & Candidate Experience

Als Senior Vice President National verantwortest du die strategische und operative Steuerung unseres nationalen Vertriebs. Du entwickelst das Geschäft, die Vertriebsorganisation und dein Team weiter und sorgst dafür, dass ambitionierte Ziele in messbare Ergebnisse übersetzt werden.

  • Verantwortung für Umsatzplanung, Forecasting, Pipeline Management und relevante Sales-KPIs
  • KPI-basierte Steuerung der Vertriebsperformance sowie kritische Analyse und Plausibilisierung von Zahlen und Forecasts
  • Analyse und Steuerung der Agenturperformance sowie Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur Ausschöpfung von Umsatz- & Wachstumspotenzialen
  • Frühzeitige Identifikation von Planabweichungen, Risiken und ungenutzten Umsatzpotenzialen
  • Ableitung und konsequente Umsetzung konkreter Maßnahmen zur Zielerreichung
  • Durchführung regelmäßiger Performance- und Business Reviews
  • Weiterentwicklung von CRM-, Reporting- und Vertriebssteuerungsprozessen
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Finance und Controlling bei Planung und Forecasting

 Leadership & Organisation
  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung des nationalen Vertriebsteams mit klarer Ergebnis- und Performanceorientierung
  • Übersetzung der Unternehmensziele in konkrete Vertriebsziele, KPIs und Verantwortlichkeiten
  • Coaching und Sparring des Teams bei Akquise, Kundenentwicklung und strategisch relevanten Vertriebsprozessen
  • Weiterentwicklung von Strukturen und Prozessen innerhalb der Vertriebsorganisation
  • Etablierung einer transparenten, datenbasierten und verbindlichen Performance-Kultur
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Produktmanagement, Operations, Finance und weiteren internen Bereichen


Das bist Du

  • Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung in einer seniorigen Vertriebsposition mit relevanter Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung
  • Fundierte Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Media-, Werbe- oder vergleichbaren Umfeld
  • Umfassende Erfahrung in der strategischen Betreuung und Steuerung von Agenturen sowie ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Agenturstrukturen, Entscheidungs- und Budgetprozessen
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Führung und Entwicklung von Vertriebsteams sowie in der Neukundenakquise und im Großkundenvertrieb
  • Ausgeprägte Erfahrung im Key Account Management und in Verhandlungen auf Entscheider- und C-Level-Ebene
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Vertriebssteuerung, Forecasting, Pipeline Management und KPI-Systemen
  • Hohe Zahlenaffinität und die Fähigkeit, Vertriebskennzahlen kritisch zu analysieren und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen abzuleiten
  • Gutes Verständnis für Pricing, Margen, Profitabilität und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge
  • Strategisches und unternehmerisches Denken kombiniert mit hoher operativer Umsetzungsstärke
  • Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsstärke
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Du verbindest Leadership, Zahlenverständnis und echte Vertriebsstärke. Du willst nicht nur wissen, ob Ziele erreicht werden, sondern verstehst, welche Entwicklungen hinter den Zahlen stehen und welche Maßnahmen notwendig sind, um die Performance zu steigern.

title: Scrum Master / Delivery Enabler (m/w/d) - KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung
description:
Du begeisterst dich für agile Delivery und willst die sich wandelnde Rolle des Scrum Masters im KI-Zeitalter aktiv mitgestalten? Und, du bist an vielfältigen Projekten in einem kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld interessiert? Dann schau dir MaibornWolff einmal näher an! 

Wir bei MaibornWolff sind ein inhabergeführtes, mittelständisches IT-Beratungsunternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Expertise. Mit rund 800 Tech-begeisterten Menschen beraten wir unsere Kunden bei ihren Digitalisierungsstrategien und entwickeln moderne, individuelle Softwarelösungen. 2024 sind wir in die Lünendonk-Liste der „führenden mittelständischen IT-Beratungen in Deutschland" aufgestiegen, worauf wir sehr stolz sind.

In unserer Delivery-Enabler Gilde arbeiten aktuell elf Scrum Master:innen, Agile Coaches und Delivery Enabler an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland. Unsere Mission: Delivery Enablement als starke, zukunftsfähige Rolle etablieren und Projekt-Teams auch im KI-Wandel wirksam unterstützen. Wir teilen Wissen, gestalten unsere Rolle gemeinsam weiter und bringen unterschiedliche Stärken ein. Unsere Projekte reichen von einzelnen Entwicklungsteams bis hin zu internationalen Programmen in Branchen wie Automotive, Energie und Public Sector.

Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als Delivery Enabler übernimmst du Verantwortung für eine Rolle im Umbruch, führst interdisziplinäre Teams durch den KI-Wandel und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Delivery Enablement zu einer starken, zukunftsfähigen Funktion weiterzuentwickeln.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Teams stärken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Entwicklungsteams zusammen: Du beseitigst Hindernisse, entwickelst konstruktive Arbeitsweisen weiter und förderst so effektive Teamstrukturen.
  • Stakeholder steuern: Du bringst die unterschiedlichen Interessen von Team, Kunde und MaibornWolff aktiv zusammen und sorgst so für einen klaren, effizienten Entscheidungs- und Kommunikationsfluss.
  • Delivery absichern: Anhand konkreter Kennzahlen machst du Wirkung und Wertbeitrag deiner Rolle sichtbar. Du schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Zielen und Erwartungen, beseitigst Hindernisse und adressierst mögliche Risiken frühzeitig.
  • KI-Agenten integrieren: Du befähigst dein Team zur optimalen Einbindung von KI-Agenten und Tools und hast die damit verbundenen Prozess- und Kommunikationsverschiebungen im Blick. Du begleitest Teams und Kunden souverän durch KI-bedingte Change Prozesse.
  • Bereich mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit deiner Delivery Enabler-Gilde entwickelst du unser Rollenverständnis weiter, teilst dein Wissen und treibst relevante Themen voran. Wenn du möchtest, engagierst du dich zusätzlich als Mentor:in in der Mitarbeitendenentwicklung oder in anderen internen Aufgaben.


Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder IT - entscheidend ist für uns jedoch deine reale Projekterfahrung.
  • Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3-5 Jahre relevante Projekterfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb der Softwareentwicklung mit. Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten.
  • Methodenkompetenz: Du beherrschst agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder Kanban und bestenfalls auch Skalierungsmodelle wie SAFe, Nexus oder LeSS. Zudem bist du stark in Stakeholder-Management, Facilitation & Workshop-Design sowie in agilen Metriken und Forecasting. Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt. 
  • Tools: Du nutzt KI-Anwendungen routiniert und zielgerichtet für deine eigene Arbeitseffizienz. Zudem hast du durch deine Projektarbeit ein klares Verständnis zu Wirkweise und möglichen Fallstricken von KI in der Softwareentwicklung gewonnen.
  • Reisebereitschaft: 
     Du bist bereit, bei Bedarf bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche zu reisen – für Workshops, Team-Events oder den direkten Austausch mit Team und Kunden vor Ort.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.


Deine Benefits

  • New Work. Home Office & Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitmodelle, Arbeitszeitkonto, Sabbatical
  • Weiterbildung. 1,5 Bruttomonatsgehälter stehen jährlich bereit, damit du deinen Horizont erweitern kannst.
  • Mitarbeiterevents. Ob Firmenseminare im Sommer oder Weihnachtsfeiern, wir feiern die kleinen und großen Anlässe.
  • Betriebliche Leistungen. Zuzahlung zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mobilitätsbudget und Sport-Angebot.
  • Forschung & Entwicklung. Stecke deine Nase bewusst auch in andere Themen rein.
  • Moderne Hard- und Software. iPhone, MacBook, Lenovo-Notebook, moderne Büroausstattung.


Du hast Fragen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Du bist aber noch unsicher, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Dann gibt es nur einen Weg: einfach bewerben! Nur so haben wir gemeinsam die Chance herauszufinden, ob es jetzt passt.
