Du begeisterst dich für agile Delivery und willst die sich wandelnde Rolle des Scrum Masters im KI-Zeitalter aktiv mitgestalten? Und, du bist an vielfältigen Projekten in einem kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld interessiert? Dann schau dir MaibornWolff einmal näher an! 

Wir bei MaibornWolff sind ein inhabergeführtes, mittelständisches IT-Beratungsunternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Expertise. Mit rund 800 Tech-begeisterten Menschen beraten wir unsere Kunden bei ihren Digitalisierungsstrategien und entwickeln moderne, individuelle Softwarelösungen. 2024 sind wir in die Lünendonk-Liste der „führenden mittelständischen IT-Beratungen in Deutschland" aufgestiegen, worauf wir sehr stolz sind.

In unserer Delivery-Enabler Gilde arbeiten aktuell elf Scrum Master:innen, Agile Coaches und Delivery Enabler an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland. Unsere Mission: Delivery Enablement als starke, zukunftsfähige Rolle etablieren und Projekt-Teams auch im KI-Wandel wirksam unterstützen. Wir teilen Wissen, gestalten unsere Rolle gemeinsam weiter und bringen unterschiedliche Stärken ein. Unsere Projekte reichen von einzelnen Entwicklungsteams bis hin zu internationalen Programmen in Branchen wie Automotive, Energie und Public Sector.

Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als Delivery Enabler übernimmst du Verantwortung für eine Rolle im Umbruch, führst interdisziplinäre Teams durch den KI-Wandel und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Delivery Enablement zu einer starken, zukunftsfähigen Funktion weiterzuentwickeln.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Teams stärken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Entwicklungsteams zusammen: Du beseitigst Hindernisse, entwickelst konstruktive Arbeitsweisen weiter und förderst so effektive Teamstrukturen.
  • Stakeholder steuern: Du bringst die unterschiedlichen Interessen von Team, Kunde und MaibornWolff aktiv zusammen und sorgst so für einen klaren, effizienten Entscheidungs- und Kommunikationsfluss.
  • Delivery absichern: Anhand konkreter Kennzahlen machst du Wirkung und Wertbeitrag deiner Rolle sichtbar. Du schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Zielen und Erwartungen, beseitigst Hindernisse und adressierst mögliche Risiken frühzeitig.
  • KI-Agenten integrieren: Du befähigst dein Team zur optimalen Einbindung von KI-Agenten und Tools und hast die damit verbundenen Prozess- und Kommunikationsverschiebungen im Blick. Du begleitest Teams und Kunden souverän durch KI-bedingte Change Prozesse.
  • Bereich mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit deiner Delivery Enabler-Gilde entwickelst du unser Rollenverständnis weiter, teilst dein Wissen und treibst relevante Themen voran. Wenn du möchtest, engagierst du dich zusätzlich als Mentor:in in der Mitarbeitendenentwicklung oder in anderen internen Aufgaben.


Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder IT - entscheidend ist für uns jedoch deine reale Projekterfahrung.
  • Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3-5 Jahre relevante Projekterfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb der Softwareentwicklung mit. Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten.
  • Methodenkompetenz: Du beherrschst agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder Kanban und bestenfalls auch Skalierungsmodelle wie SAFe, Nexus oder LeSS. Zudem bist du stark in Stakeholder-Management, Facilitation & Workshop-Design sowie in agilen Metriken und Forecasting. Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt. 
  • Tools: Du nutzt KI-Anwendungen routiniert und zielgerichtet für deine eigene Arbeitseffizienz. Zudem hast du durch deine Projektarbeit ein klares Verständnis zu Wirkweise und möglichen Fallstricken von KI in der Softwareentwicklung gewonnen.
  • Reisebereitschaft: 
     Du bist bereit, bei Bedarf bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche zu reisen – für Workshops, Team-Events oder den direkten Austausch mit Team und Kunden vor Ort.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.


Deine Benefits

  • New Work. Home Office & Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitmodelle, Arbeitszeitkonto, Sabbatical
  • Weiterbildung. 1,5 Bruttomonatsgehälter stehen jährlich bereit, damit du deinen Horizont erweitern kannst.
  • Mitarbeiterevents. Ob Firmenseminare im Sommer oder Weihnachtsfeiern, wir feiern die kleinen und großen Anlässe.
  • Betriebliche Leistungen. Zuzahlung zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mobilitätsbudget und Sport-Angebot.
  • Forschung & Entwicklung. Stecke deine Nase bewusst auch in andere Themen rein.
  • Moderne Hard- und Software. iPhone, MacBook, Lenovo-Notebook, moderne Büroausstattung.


Du hast Fragen?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Du bist aber noch unsicher, ob du alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Dann gibt es nur einen Weg: einfach bewerben! Nur so haben wir gemeinsam die Chance herauszufinden, ob es jetzt passt.

Die gemeinnützige Flossbach von Storch Stiftung engagiert sich mit Passion für die Förderung von Wirtschafts- und Finanzbildung. Vor diesem Hintergrund wurde 2006 die Flossbach von Storch Stiftung gegründet. Ihre Aktivitäten sind in drei Bereiche gegliedert: Projektarbeit, Förderung von Wissenschaft, Forschung und Lehre sowie bildungspolitisches Engagement. Zur Unterstützung des Teams bei der Projektarbeit und um noch mehr Menschen zu erreichen, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) in Köln mit 15 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche für mindestens 6 Monate.

  • Pflege und Ausbau unserer Social-Media-Kanäle (insbesondere Instagram und LinkedIn)

  • Interaktion mit unserer Community, Beantwortung von Kommentaren und Nachrichten

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du hast Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Ideen und Konzepten und verfügst über eine hohe Affinität zu Social Media, insbesondere Instagram und LinkedIn
  • Kenntnisse: Du verfügst über Basiskenntnisse im Bereich Wirtschaft und Finanzen
  • Qualifikation: Du bist eingeschriebener Bachelor- oder Masterstudent (m/w/d) der Fachrichtungen Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Lehramt, Wirtschaftsjournalismus, Kommunikationswissenschaft oder Marketing

  • Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Ausgeprägter Team- und Netzwerkgedanke 
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding

title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Azure (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns

Bei Flossbach von Storch kümmern wir uns mit 400 Mitarbeitenden um das Vermögen von etwa einer Million Menschen – unabhängig davon, wie groß es ist. Unsere Verantwortung ist stets die gleiche: ihr Vermögen zu schützen und langfristig mehr daraus machen. Damit sie ihr Leben nach den eigenen Vorstellungen gestalten können. 

Im Rahmen unserer Multi-Cloud-Strategie ist DevOps zentral für unsere Produktteams und unsere Informationssicherheit. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams Security, Infrastructure & Cloud am Standort Köln suchen wir daher einen Senior DevOps Engineer – Azure (m/w/d), der unsere Azure-Infrastruktur aktiv mitgestaltet sowie moderne Cloud- und DevOps-Lösungen entwickelt und weiterentwickelt.


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Gestaltung, Implementierung und Betrieb unserer Azure-Infrastruktur mit Infrastructure as Code – inklusive der Microservices-Infrastruktur unserer neuen Webseite
  • Weiterentwicklung unserer Azure-Identitätsarchitektur mit Entra ID, Service Principals, Managed Identities und Zero Trust 
  • Betrieb und Optimierung unserer CI/CD-Pipelines sowie Verankerung von DevSecOps-Prinzipien 
  • Mitgestaltung Cloud-nativer Architekturen gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Partnern 
  • Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen, Betriebskonzepte und Entscheidungsvorlagen


Ihr Profil

  • Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, eine vergleichbare Ausbildung oder ein vergleichbarer beruflicher Werdegang mit entsprechender Praxiserfahrung
  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb und Design von DevOps-Infrastrukturen, idealerweise im Azure-Umfeld
  • Kenntnisse: 
    • Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform und/oder Azure Bicep 
    • Microsoft Entra ID sowie OAuth, OIDC und Microsoft Graph API 
    • Azure Networking, z. B. Hub-Spoke, Load-Balancing, DNS, Routing und Firewall 
    • Programmier- und Skriptkenntnisse, z. B. in Python oder Bash, für Automatisierung und CI/CD-Pipelines 
    • Monitoring mit Grafana, Prometheus oder Elastic Stack 
    • Idealerweise Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud, Purview oder Azure OpenAI 
  • Darüber hinaus: Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein 
  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 


Unser Team

Wir sind ein neunköpfiges Team mit Begeisterung für moderne Cloud-, Infrastruktur- und Security-Technologien. Wir sind neugierig und haben Spaß daran, uns fortlaufend in neue Technologien und Themen einzuarbeiten. Sicherheit, Stabilität und Qualität stehen für uns an oberster Stelle. Gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Partnern gestalten und entwickeln wir unsere Cloud-Infrastruktur kontinuierlich weiter.


Unser Angebot

  • Erfolgreiches, inhabergeführtes Unternehmen mit schnellen Entscheidungswegen und langfristigem Fokus 
  • Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen 
  • Ausgeprägter Team- und Netzwerkgedanke  
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding sowie fachliche und methodische Trainings  
  • Vielfältige Arbeitgeberleistungen: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Deutschlandticket, hybrides Arbeitsmodell, Mitarbeitenden-Restaurant, Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote und vieles mehr

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Who we are

Welcome to one of Europe’s most exciting New Space companies, creating the world's first fully connected mesh network in the sky. We are an international team of experts and engineers who have spent their careers expanding the boundaries and potential of space, now united in pursuit of a single vision. •    Assisting in the preparation of annual financial statements in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) and U.S. GAAP

•    Serve as the liaison between accounts payable and accounts receivable, as well as other financial departments such as Treasury and Controlling

•    Nice to have:  initial experience in US GAAP reporting

•    Proficiency in using common accounting, financial reporting, and tax software such as DATEV and NetSuite (and interfaces to these)

•    A high degree of initiative and interest in actively shaping and further developing processes

•    Good command of English and very good written and spoken German

•    A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to work

•    A strong hands-on mindset and a passion for taking on responsibility in a dynamic startup or growth environment

•    A high degree of initiative and interest in actively shaping and further developing processes


Why you should join us

We are an international team of space enthusiasts, following one great vision. We value equality in our work environment where different opinions, backgrounds and experiences are not only welcomed but also necessary to achieve the best result collaboratively. This permanent position was created recently and thus offers a lot of creative freedom. Our approach is to create a modern work environment with hybrid working model. We offer an attractive salary depending on your experience. Rivada Space Networks is an equal opportunity employer with the approach to create a diverse and inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, disability, or other individual characteristics.

GermanDream ist Deutschlands präsenteste Bildungsbewegung für gelebte Demokratie und Teilhabe. Wir stärken Jugendliche, Lehrkräfte und pädagogische Fachkräfte darin, Antisemitismus zu erkennen, einzuordnen und ihm handlungssicher zu begegnen. What You’ll Do:

Our Operations happen on a restaurant floor, in a lively neighbourhood, at a busy bar - we operate in the city:

  • Run restaurant onboarding: train, connect and implement together with the restaurant team

  • Good communication - you are great at proactive contact and managing expectations

  • Being comfortable with high-pace environments: both the hospitality flow and the startup day-to-day

  • Flexibility in working hours to fit our merchants’ needs

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

Lead Product Engineer (a)

title: Technical Program Manager (Science)
description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.



The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with a strong technical or scientific background (Natural Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering and/or AI/ML) to join our team in Cambridge or London. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates cutting-edge scientific research and tool/model development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our internal technical teams on coordinating complex scientific campaigns and also manage scoping and delivery of high-stakes customer projects. You will also be involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles and improvements to end to end technical delivery.


What You Will Do

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead internal technical programs across frontier research, AI/ML model development, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between materials scientists, AI researchers and engineers.

  • Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams.

  • Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery.

  • Own planning and delivery of projects; calculating compute, managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes.

Partner & Customer Collaboration

  • Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects.

  • Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Drive project scoping and proposal writing in collaboration with the partnerships and technical teams.

  • Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment.

Process & Operations

  • Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes.

  • Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes.

  • Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs.

  • Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes.

  • Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation.

  • Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer facing processes.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You possess a strong background in a Natural Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or related field.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager in a scientific or AI/ML environment, with a clear sense of where the opportunities and challenges in the field lie.

  • Technical fluency across model architecture, cloud infrastructure, and the software development lifecycle.

  • Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams.

  • The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering).

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority.

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.

  • Experience managing technical external-facing customer projects.


Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics.

  • Hands-on experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure or scientific data management.

  • Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools.

Additional Considerations

This role will be based in our London or Cambridge office, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations (Amsterdam and Berlin) for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

title: Signal Processing Engineer (Radar)
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets.

  • Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data.

  • Build jamming estimation capabilities, combining out-of-band spectral sniffing with in-band spatial covariance analysis, and the adaptive logic that drives radar behavior in response.

  • Contribute radar-derived observables and algorithms that support navigation when GNSS is unavailable.

  • Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints.

  • Validate algorithms end-to-end through hardware-in-the-loop bench testing, anechoic chamber campaigns, and real flight conditions, iterating quickly on results.

  • Work closely with the EW and RF analytics modules to align signal processing development with system-level requirements.

Candidate Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of confirmed, hands-on experience in radar signal processing, gained in the defense or automotive radar industry preferably.

  • Solid experience in Signal Processing on radar systems, either FMCW or pulsed, is required; exposure to moving target tracking, ECCM, radar-based navigation, or live/real-time processing is a strong plus.

  • Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions.

  • A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight.

  • Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

employer: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description:
Contexte :

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Au sein de la Direction de la formation, le pôle « admissions, scolarité, stages », assure le cadre administratif de gestion des élèves dans leurs parcours de formation. Il agit en fonction support des directeurs de programme.

 

Le/la titulaire du poste est affecté(e) au sein de la Direction de la Formation, sur le site de Brest, et est rattaché(e) hiérarchiquement à la Directrice du pôle « admissions, scolarité, stages ».

Dans ce cadre, l’ENSTA recrute, pour son campus de Brest, un/une gestionnaire administratif qui assurera le suivi des dossiers élèves, en particulier des élèves militaires sous statut d’IETA (Ingénieur des études et techniques de l’armement)

 

Missions / Activités principales :

 

Le titulaire du poste est chargé(e) du suivi administratif des élèves civils :

  • Elaboration et la diffusion des certificats de scolarité et autres documents de scolarité (certificat d'inscription ...)

  • Suivi d’attestation CVEC

  • Suivi des bourses étudiantes, en lien avec le CROUS, en qualité de correspondant(e) bourses.

  • Gestion des cartes étudiantes,

  • Gestion des demandes de financements par la formation continue,

  • Gestion des déplacements et répartition des étudiants pour les actions de promotion de l’offre de formation,

  • Participation aux activités du pôle

 

Sous l'autorité fonctionnelle du Directeur des études IETA et de l'Adjointe Officiers des corps de l'armement, le/la titulaire du poste assure la gestion administrative des élèves sous statut IETA (Ingénieur des études et techniques de l’armement) :

 

  • Assurer la gestion administrative et le suivi individuel des élèves militaires : dossiers, solde, cartes militaires, suivi médical, permissions, affectations, arrêts de travail, accidents, décorations, etc ;

  • Assurer la liaison avec le service médical de la base navale de Brest ;

  • Assurer la gestion et le suivi des habilitations des étudiants civils et des personnels du campus de Brest ;

  • Veiller au respect des procédures, à la confidentialité et à la tenue à jour des dossiers.

 

Activités annexes :

  • Elaborer des tableaux de bords pour les enquêtes, statistiques et bilans

  • Actualisation des dossiers élèves dans le SI de scolarité.

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement ;

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole.

 

Niveau de diplôme et formations :

Bac à Bac+2 en gestion administrative, gestion des ressources humaines ou dans un domaine équivalent, avec une expérience professionnelle similaire. Une expérience dans des environnements liés à l'enseignement supérieur et/au ministère des armées serait un plus.

 

 Emploi :

Poste ouvert aux candidats :

  • Fonctionnaire de catégorie C - RIFSEEP 1

  • Agent contractuel de catégorie C (emploi pérenne ; CDD de 1 à 3 ans renouvelable) CDI possible après 2 ans de CDD

Ce poste nécessite une habilitation « SECRET »

 

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : 3 à 5 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : 1er novembre 2026

Rémunération :

  • Fonctionnaires : selon les conditions statutaires (grille indiciaire, IFSE, CIA)

  • Contractuels : en fonction de l'expérience professionnelle sur des postes de niveau équivalent

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus de Brest,

« Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ».

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après période d’essai et après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion,

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

 

 Présentation de l’Ecole :

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.


Profil attendu :

 

Connaissances :

  • Règles et méthodes de gestion administrative

  • Expression écrite et orale en français et anglais

  • Organisation et fonctionnement de l’enseignement supérieur

  • Organisation et fonctionnement de la DGA

 

 

Savoir-faire :

  • Savoir appliquer les dispositions réglementaires

  • Être à l’aise avec les systèmes d’information

  • Être à l’aise avec les logiciels de bureautique

  • Savoir analyser et synthétiser des informations

  • Utiliser les techniques de rédaction administrative

  • Savoir appliquer les règles, protocoles et procédures

  • Savoir planifier son temps et s’organiser de manière méthodique

 

Savoir-être :

  • Discrétion professionnelle

  • Sens des relations humaines

  • Curiosité

  • Autonomie

  • Travail en équipe

  • Rigueur et organisation

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Full Stack growth path)
Superviseur·se CVC/HAVC - Pompes à chaleur - France
description:
Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et la satisfaction client.

Notre objectif est clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance !

Dans le cadre du lancement et du déploiement de nos pompes à chaleur en France, nous recherchons notre premier·ère Superviseur·ise CVC/HVAC pour superviser les installations de nos pompes à chaleur air-air. Nous recherchons une personne passionnée, ayant de l’expérience dans l’installation de pompes à chaleur et/ou systèmes de chauffage et désireuse de nous aider à développer cette activité en France.

Il s’agit d’un poste sur le terrain couvrant la région d’Amiens, mais tu seras également amené·e à travailler depuis ton domicile ou depuis notre bureau de Lille lorsque cela sera nécessaire.


Ce que tu feras
- Tu nous aideras à mettre en place la structure technique de notre département dédié aux pompes à chaleur en France
- Tu veilleras à la qualité et au bon fonctionnement des installations réalisées par nos partenaires locaux
- Tu seras sur le terrain pour visiter les chantiers et t’assurer de leur bon déroulement
- Tu seras en mesure d’apporter une assistance technique pour résoudre directement tout problème identifié sur place
- Tu auras un esprit « dépanneur » pour trouver des solutions aux défis rencontrés et les résoudre à ton échelle
- Tu mettras à profit tes connaissances et ton expérience en matière d’installations de pompes à chaleur pour garantir une expérience fluide et exceptionnelle
- Tu conseilleras nos clients et tu les aideras à mettre en places les bonnes pratique de réduction des émissions carbone
- Tu examineras les cahiers des charges techniques et les plans techniques de nos pompes à chaleur, et tu pourras participer à leur élaboration/amélioration continue, en lien avec les équipes techniques & métiers du groupe

title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
description:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies
  • Communication Connection and Service 
  • Global Mindset 
  • Achieving Results 
  • Driving Innovation and Managing Change 
  • Learning and Development 
  • Drives Vision and Leads Courageously
  • Strong focus on quality and continuous improvement 
  • Leadership skills 
  • Strong intercultural communication skills and cultural agility

title: Agentic Compiler Engineer
description:
ABOUT KOG

Kog builds a co-designed inference stack for real-time AI agents on standard datacenter GPUs, spanning model architecture, inference engine, compilers, and low-level GPU kernels.

On the model side, we developed Laneformer 2B and Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP), a Transformer architecture that overlaps communication with useful computation and weight streaming.

On the systems side, the Kog Inference Engine runs this stack on standard AMD and NVIDIA datacenter GPUs.

Kog generates 3,500 tokens/s per request on 8 AMD MI300X GPUs and 2,100 tokens/s per request on 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, in FP16 at batch size 1, with quantization and speculative decoding disabled.

Our next major project is AGCO, our agentic compiler. AGCO is designed to optimize LLMs across different GPUs and optimization targets, including very fast inference.

The team has 10 people, including 9 engineers and researchers and 4 PhDs.

Test it at playground.kog.ai. Read the technical details on the Kog Labs blog.

 

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

You will work directly on AGCO.

The goal is to build a system that can explore ways to optimize LLM execution, generate changes, compile them, check correctness, run them on real hardware, measure the results, and use this feedback to guide the next optimization.

You will contribute to areas such as:

  • Compiler and IR design for representing and transforming LLM computations.

  • Optimization passes, lowering, and code generation.

  • Search methods for exploring different implementations and execution strategies.

  • Verification and correctness checks for generated changes.

  • GPU execution, profiling, and performance optimization.

  • LLM inference across operators, memory, parallelism, and communication.

  • Optimization loops that connect generated changes to measurements on real GPUs.

One direction we are exploring combines an IR, a verifier, a compiler, and a search optimizer. We plan to start with focused problems, build working prototypes, and extend the system from what we learn.

Your main area will depend on your experience, skills, and interests. You may focus more on compilers, GPU systems, or LLM inference while working closely with people across the full stack.

 

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

We look for engineers with deep technical expertise and original work in at least one area relevant to AGCO.

Relevant experience includes:

  • Compiler engineering, including optimization passes, IRs, lowering, code generation, LLVM, or MLIR.

  • GPU programming with CUDA, HIP, Metal, Vulkan, or similar technologies.

  • GPU performance work involving kernels, memory, synchronization, profiling, or hardware behavior.

  • LLM inference engines and performance optimization.

  • Attention, MoE, parallelism, communication, or other systems-level parts of LLM execution.

  • Formal verification, equivalence checking, SAT/SMT, or related methods.

title: Responsable bourses et mobilité internationale F/H
description:
Vos missions

Vous assurez la gestion des dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale des étudiants et des personnels et contribuez au pilotage de celui-ci.

Vous garantissez la qualité, la conformité et le suivi administratif et financier des dispositifs de bourses, notamment dans le cadre du programme Erasmus+.

En complément de cette mission principale, vous contribuez à la mise en œuvre des engagements de l’UTC dans le cadre de la Charte Erasmus+ et de ses grandes priorités, inclusion et diversité, transition écologique, transformation numérique, participation à la vie démocratique et aux valeurs européennes.

Dans ce cadre, vous participez au développement d’actions à destination des étudiants et des personnels : événements, actions de sensibilisation, formations courtes, ressources et formations en ligne.

En tant que référent-e « Transition numérique » Erasmus+ de la DRI, vous accompagnez également la transformation numérique des processus de mobilité et participez activement au déploiement, au paramétrage fonctionnel et à l’appropriation du logiciel de gestion de la mobilité internationale et des partenariats universitaires au sein de la DRI.

Vos activités

1. Coordonner l’activité du pôle « Bourses »

  • Assurer la gestion des différents dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale des étudiants et des personnels

  • Coordonner la gestion des bourses Erasmus+ et des autres dispositifs de financement nationaux, régionaux ou institutionnels

  • Organiser et promouvoir les bourses de mobilités internationales (campagnes d’attribution des aides, information et accompagnement des étudiants et personnels)

  • Assurer le suivi administratif et financier des dossiers de bourses de mobilité internationale et budgets dédiés

  • Produire les données, indicateurs, bilans et statistiques

  • Garantir le respect des critères d’éligibilité, des procédures et des règles propres aux différents programmes

  • Participer à la définition et à l’évolution des critères et procédures, dans une logique de simplification, de fiabilisation et d’amélioration continue.

  • Contribuer aux rapports Erasmus+, aux bilans institutionnels ainsi qu’aux contrôles et audits éventuels

  • Assurer une veille sur l’évolution des dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale

2. Accompagner le déploiement de la solution numérique dédiée à la gestion de la mobilité internationale et la transformation numérique des processus

Dans le cadre du déploiement de cet outil à l’UTC, vous participez à la transformation et à la dématérialisation des processus de gestion de la mobilité internationale.

À ce titre, vous contribuez notamment au/à l’:

  • Déploiement de la solution numérique : analyse des processus existants, workflows, tests, paramétrage…

  • Amélioration régulière : cohérence, fiabilité des données, évolution

  • Accompagnement des membres du service : prise en main, tutoriels

  • Accompagnement des étudiants et personnels

  • Développement d’une utilisation experte progressive : indicateurs et suivi… 

Vous participez ainsi à faire de la solution numérique un outil d’amélioration et de transformation des processus. 

3. Contribuer à la mise en œuvre des priorités de la Charte Erasmus+

Contribuer à la déclinaison opérationnelle des engagements de l’UTC dans le cadre de la Charte Erasmus+ et de ses quatre grandes priorités :

  • Inclusion et diversité : favoriser l’accès à la mobilité des publics ayant moins d’opportunités et améliorer leur accompagnement.

  • Transition écologique : promouvoir une mobilité internationale plus responsable et sensibiliser aux enjeux environnementaux.

  • Transformation numérique : développer les usages et ressources numériques liés à la mobilité et accompagner la dématérialisation des dispositifs Erasmus+.

  • Participation et citoyenneté européenne : développer des actions favorisant la connaissance de l’Europe, de ses valeurs et des opportunités offertes par Erasmus+. 

4. Contribuer à la promotion des actions et événements à destination des étudiants

Contribuer à la promotion de la mobilité internationale et des priorités Erasmus+ :

  • événements étudiants (Erasmus Days, rencontres interculturelles, témoignages, challenges, etc.) ;

  • ateliers de préparation au départ et de valorisation du retour de mobilité ;

  • actions autour de l’Europe, de l’inclusion, de l’interculturalité et de la mobilité durable. 

5. Contribuer au développement des formations courtes et des ressources pédagogiques

Contribuer à la conception et à l’animation de formations courtes, ateliers et ressources pédagogiques, en présentiel, en ligne ou en format hybride, dans le contexte de la mission (tutoriels et ressources numériques destinés aux étudiants et personnels). 

6. Participer aux projets transversaux de la DRI

Participer, selon les besoins, aux projets transversaux de la Direction aux Relations Internationales : projets Erasmus+, alliance européenne SUNRISE, événements internationaux, actions de promotion de la mobilité, internationalisation des formations et démarches d’amélioration continue

Travailler en interaction avec les autres pôles de la DRI, les services et enseignants de l’UTC, les associations étudiantes et les partenaires institutionnels.

Informations complémentaires

Dates pour candidater

Du 29/09/2026 au 29/10/2026

Type de recrutement et date prévisionnelle de recrutement

Poste ouvert aux personnels de catégorie A assistant ingénieur, par voie statutaire (mutation, détachement) ou contractuelle (contrat à durée déterminée d’un an, prolongation possible pouvant aboutir à un CDI) – pourvoi immédiat

Salaire mensuel brut

Suivant statut ou par la voie contractuelle, selon expérience

Pour les fonctionnaires, RIFSEEP : ASI - Groupe 1

Pour les agents contractuels, salaire mensuel brut de 1 867 euros à 3 111 euros, selon expérience

Volume horaire

Congés

Environnement et contexte de travail

Vous intégrerez la direction aux relations internationales et serez placé(e) sous la responsabilité hiérarchique de la directrice aux relations internationales.

Des déplacements occasionnels (formations, réunions, évènements) sont à prévoir.

Contexte

L’ouverture à l’international constitue un pilier du modèle pédagogique de l’UTC et ce depuis sa création. Elle se traduit par une stratégie internationale ambitieuse, des projets d’envergure comme des campus à l’international et une alliance des universités européennes et d’autres projets et partenariats structurants. L’UTC a aujourd’hui plus de 220 partenaires internationaux dans le monde. Certains de ces partenariats ont plus de 40 ans d’existence. L’UTC continue à consolider un réseau européen solide et vise à être un acteur clé dans l’évolution du modèle de l’enseignement supérieur européen. 

Dans ce cadre, l’établissement vise une mobilité internationale sortante de 100% des étudiants de l’UTC. La mobilité Erasmus+ s’envisage dans ce contexte de la promotion de la mobilité, à la gestion des bourses associés jusqu’aux retours de la mobilité.

Pour renforcer cette mobilité, nous accompagnons les étudiantes et étudiants de l’UTC dans l’ensemble des démarches y compris l’obtention des bourses de mobilité internationale.

Finalement, la direction aux relations internationales vise également à promouvoir l’interculturalité, renforcer l’inclusion, la digitalisation et la transition environnementale et ce dans le respect des priorités de la charte Erasmus+ et celles de la stratégie de l’UTC. 

La personne recrutée pourrait contribuer à proposer et développer des actions pour l’implémentation des priorités de la charte Erasmus+ à l’UTC. 


Diplôme et formation

Diplôme : Bac + 2 au minimum, DUT ou licence apprécié(e)

Domaine de formation : Gestion administrative, relations internationales, langues étrangères appliquées.

Expérience

Première expérience professionnelle dans un établissement d’enseignement supérieur vivement souhaitée

Connaissances

Connaissance ou capacité à s’approprier rapidement le programme Erasmus+ et les dispositifs de mobilité internationale

Connaissance des principes de gestion administrative et financière

Intérêt pour les enjeux européens, l’internationalisation de l’enseignement supérieur et les priorités du programme Erasmus+

Intérêt pour l’innovation pédagogique et les nouveaux formats d’accompagnement des étudiants

Très bonne maîtrise du français.

Bonne maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais permettant d’interagir avec les étudiants et partenaires internationaux et de travailler sur la documentation Erasmus+. (niveau B1 minimum)

title: FPGA Engineer - Electronic Warfare
description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

  • Own the development of FPGA functions for our electronic warfare and signals intelligence capabilities, from initial architecture to validation on operational hardware.

  • Work with systems and algorithm engineers to define processing requirements and assess implementation feasibility.

  • Build RTL modules in VHDL or SystemVerilog to process digitized RF signals, extract relevant information, and generate waveforms.

  • Adapt and validate DSP algorithms for FPGA implementation, balancing numerical accuracy, processing speed, and hardware resources.

  • Integrate acquisition and processing chains, including digital down-conversion, filtering, channelization, FFT, detection, direction-finding, and classification.

  • Establish verification methods and testbenches to check functional behavior and performance throughout development.

  • Connect programmable logic to RF converters and embedded processors, defining data transfers, control interfaces, clocking, and synchronization.

  • Resolve implementation constraints, achieve timing closure, and optimize resource utilization and power consumption.

  • Bring up FPGA designs on target boards, investigate integration issues, and correlate measured behavior with simulation results.

  • Contribute to laboratory and field testing alongside RF, software, and systems engineers.

  • Maintain clear design records, interface specifications, and validation evidence.

  • Improve reusable FPGA components and development practices as the product portfolio grows.

Candidate Profile

  • MSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Signal Processing, or a related field.

  • Strong experience developing and verifying RTL in VHDL or SystemVerilog, with a focus on digital signal processing.

  • Practical experience implementing designs on SoC FPGAs, including synthesis, implementation, timing analysis, and hardware debugging.

  • Strong understanding of sampled signals, frequency conversion, digital filtering, spectral analysis, and fixed-point numerical behavior.

  • Ability to reason across FPGA, processor, and RF hardware boundaries when making design decisions.

  • Experience modelling algorithms and comparing reference models with hardware results; familiarity with MATLAB, Simulink, Python, or HLS is a plus.

  • Familiarity with RF measurements and laboratory equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes, is a plus.

  • Prior experience in electronic warfare is welcome but not required.


Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on engineer who enjoys taking designs from simulation to working hardware.

  • Methodical approach to debugging, with the ability to isolate problems across complex signal chains.

  • Able to own a technical scope independently and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.

  • Rigorous approach to verification, documentation, and design traceability.

  • Comfortable collaborating across disciplines and adapting to evolving product requirements.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-growing company.

  • High integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive defense technologies.

title: AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering.

You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases.

This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making.

You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics.

Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems.

What you will do

  • Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost.

  • Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools.

  • Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs.

  • Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation.

  • Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations.

  • Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior.

  • Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation.

About you

  • You have deep expertise in crashworthiness, solid mechanics, and structural mechanics, with substantial experience in industrial simulation workflows.

  • You have a Master’s degree or equivalent technical depth in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, civil/structural engineering, computational mechanics, applied physics, or a related field.

  • You have 4+ years of relevant industrial experience (or PhD +1 years) in domains such as automotive, aerospace, and consumer electronics.

  • You have hands-on experience with explicit dynamics for crash or impact simulation and understand nonlinear FEM and related topics such as contact, plasticity, structural dynamics, buckling, material modeling, fracture/damage, fatigue, crashworthiness, or durability.

  • You have direct experience with simulation validation, correlation, model quality, numerical sensitivity, and engineering KPI definition.

  • You are a strong Python developer who can build and maintain reliable tools for simulation automation, data processing, and model evaluation. You apply sound software engineering practices, including version control with Git, automated testing, code review, and clear documentation.

  • You have hands-on experience working in Linux and HPC environments, including submitting and monitoring batch jobs, selecting appropriate compute resources, and troubleshooting simulation workflows. You can run simulation campaigns efficiently across a compute cluster.

  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguous technical environments and turning poorly defined industrial problems into scoped datasets, experiments, metrics, and execution plans.

  • You communicate clearly with both deep technical experts and non-specialist stakeholders.

It would be great if you

  • Have experience applying machine learning, surrogate modeling, reduced-order modeling, optimization, or data-driven methods to simulation problems.

  • Have contributed to reusable internal tools, open-source code, simulation automation frameworks, or production-quality engineering workflows.

  • Have experience working directly with industrial customers, product teams, or engineering decision-makers.

  • Have publications, patents, internal technical leadership, or recognized contributions in engineering, simulation, computational mechanics, or ML-for-physics communities.

title: Senior AI Data Engineer  (x/f/m)
Network Developer
description:
Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do

  • Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

  • Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

  • Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

  • Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

  • Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

  • Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

  • Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

  • Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

  • Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

  • Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

  • Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

  • You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

  • You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

  • AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

  • You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

  • A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

  • Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

  • Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

  • 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

  • Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

  • Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

  • DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.


What you will do

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

  • ITSM Platform Ownership (JSM): Administering, configuring, and continuously evolving Jira Service Management — including service catalog design, SLA management, queue configuration, request type rationalization, and automated routing. You treat JSM as a product, not a ticket system.

  • Atlassian Suite Administration: Managing the full Atlassian Cloud ecosystem (Jira Software, Confluence, JSM, Guard, Loom, Trello, Bitbucket) with deep expertise in governance, user access management, project templates, and platform health monitoring.

  • Automation Engineering: Designing and implementing sophisticated workflow automations — using Atlassian Automation, REST APIs, and third-party middleware — that eliminate manual processes and scale operations without adding headcount.

  • Enterprise Integration Architecture: Building and maintaining integrations between Atlassian and adjacent enterprise systems (Slack, HR platforms, identity providers, monitoring tools) using webhooks, APIs, and marketplace apps.

  • CMDB & Asset Management: Owning JSM Assets configuration, data integrity, and lifecycle management across IT hardware, software licenses, and configuration items (CIs) — ensuring a reliable, audit-ready source of truth.

  • ITSM Process Governance: Defining and enforcing ITIL-aligned processes including incident management, change management, problem management, and access management — translating business needs into governed, automated workflows.

title: Network Developer
description:
Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do

  • Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

  • Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

  • Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

  • Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

  • Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

  • Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

  • Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

  • Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

  • Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

  • Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

  • Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

  • You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

  • You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

  • AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

  • You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

  • A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

  • Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

  • Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

  • 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

  • Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

  • Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

  • DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)
